name: get_event_source_object_id

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_GetEventSourceObjectId increments Script stackTop and pushes ScriptRuntime.eventSourceObjectId

notes: func_001C6530 stores its first argument in ScriptRuntime.eventSourceObjectId at offset 0x3170 before starting event Script entry 0; its JP callers pass encoded object IDs in this argument. Command 357 can override the same event-context field from Script code. All 17 JP calls immediately store the result and pair it with command 356; 14 compare it with encoded object IDs 0x40001 or 0x40014, while the other three test it for a nonzero value.
